minor_rule: Users under 16 are routed to guardian consent; users aged 16 or older consent for themselves.
consent_screen: One required Accept button covers account operation, product analytics, personalization, and partner measurement.
optional_controls: Analytics and personalization can be disabled later in account settings.
guardian_verification: Email confirmation link to the guardian address supplied by the user.
withdrawal: Users may withdraw optional processing in account settings.
retention_notice: Account data is retained while the account is active; analytics event retention is not stated in the flow.
